issues_detected.title: Ceiling Water Stain
issues_detected.description: A large, circular water stain is present on the ceiling, indicating a possible leak from above.
issues_detected.recommendation: Investigate the source of the leak, which could be from plumbing or roof issues. Repair the leak and replace or treat the stained ceiling material.

analysis.overall_assessment: The room shows signs of water damage on the ceiling, which requires further investigation and repair.
